items.headline: US Enacts Common Cents Act to End Penny Production
items.summary: On November 20, 2026, the United States officially signed the Common Cents Act into law, halting the production of the penny for general circulation. The legislation establishes federal guidance allowing businesses to round cash transactions to the nearest nickel while keeping existing pennies as legal tender.

items.headline: Global Tech Stocks Plunge as Anthropic IPO Fails to Calm AI Market Fears
items.summary: On November 20, 2026, global technology stocks suffered a severe sell-off that dragged the Nasdaq Composite down over five percent and erased its annual gains. The market slide deepened even as AI firm Anthropic completed its landmark public debut, highlighting growing investor skepticism about heavy artificial intelligence spending.

items.headline: A Lim Kim Hits Ace to Lead LPGA Season Finale as Nelly Korda Stays in Hunt
items.summary: South Korea's A Lim Kim fired an eight-under-par 64, featuring a hole-in-one on the 16th hole, to take a three-shot lead after Friday's second round at the CME Group Tour Championship in Florida. World No. 1 Nelly Korda shot a 67 to stay three strokes back in pursuit of the tournament's $4 million winner's payout and a potential LPGA Hall of Fame berth.

items.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI Sets Entertainment Record With $3.79 Billion in Day-One Sales
items.summary: Rockstar Games announced that Grand Theft Auto VI generated $3.79 billion in retail sales on its first day, driven by more than 32 million pre-ordered copies. The historic opening makes the title the highest-grossing debut across all entertainment media in history.
